title: Dodobian — a classic Linux desktop on Debian
desc: Dodobian is a Linux distribution built on Debian around Dodo Desktop: a classic desktop with a panel, a menu and windows you drive with the mouse, with rounded corners and soft shadows. Work in progress.
h1:
The dodo is back.
This time on Debian.
lead: Dodobian is a Linux distribution built on Debian around Dodo Desktop: a classic desktop with a panel, a menu and windows you drive with the mouse. Rounded corners and soft shadows included, like the windows on this page.
hint: Go on, drag one by its title bar.
inside: Ordinary .deb packages: apt upgrade updates the desktop and its settings.
Rounded corners and a soft shadow on every window.
Each monitor has its own. Add and remove them as on macOS.
Everything works with the mouse. Shortcuts too.
done: Packages built in CI for amd64 and arm64
